reason: A TIFF media-processing tool that decodes local files or HTTP(S) URLs into PNGs, reports metadata, and optionally obtains descriptions from a configured vision endpoint.

summaries.zh: 用于读取和解码 TIFF/TIF 图像、转换为 PNG、提供页面与头部元数据，并可选调用配置的视觉模型生成文字描述。
summaries.en: Reads and decodes TIFF/TIF images, converts pages to PNG, reports header and page metadata, and optionally uses a configured vision model to generate text descriptions.

capabilities: Downloads TIFF/TIF files from HTTP(S) URLs
Decodes TIFF pages and writes converted PNG files
Reports TIFF header and page metadata
Optionally sends decoded PNG content to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for text description
